title: ADR-0150: amendment note — a package-less action row on an object no holder binds is the environment's own item (D4 action key; ruling on #34059)
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTkZnXtRhuEiiyidvJ

Filing gate: a governed text owed by a maintainer ruling. The ruling on #34059 (record 6902014292, option B 「算环境自己的新动作」) says the save fix "needs an ADR-0150 amendment note for object-bound actions (L181 / R15 read against the D4 action key)". The code half is PR #34238 (`Fixes #34059`, server area S4). `docs/adr/**` is `domain:skills` text and Tier H, so the note is filed here, not folded into the server PR.
Prior rulings read: maintainer ruling 6902014292 on #34059; ADR-0150 D4 (the action key `(package, objectName, name)`), L181 ("a package-less row that bears a package-held name is a customization, never a second item"), R15; #33898 (the read envelope and the action route key by object). Dedupe: searched open issues for `ADR-0150 amendment action`. The hits are #34059 (the code card) and #31527 (the design epic), and neither carries the note.

## 维护者速读

- 改什么：给 ADR-0150 补一条注记。动作绑在对象上时，“包持有的名字，不带包名的行就是该包的定制”这条（L181、R15）按 D4 的动作键 `(package, objectName, name)` 来读。环境在一个持有者都没绑的对象上不带包名保存同名动作，得到的是环境自己的动作，不会写进那个包。
- 为什么：维护者在 #34059 选了方案 B，裁决要求补这条注记。代码在 PR #34238。
- 需要你做的：Tier H 文本，合并需要维护者本人批准。

## The note (drafted by the #34059 dev, report 6905929323; the lane owns the final wording)

After D4's customization paragraph (L181), with a pointer from R15 (L311):

> **Amendment note (2026-11-16, #34059 — PR #34238; maintainer ruling 6902014292).** For an action bound to an object, the customization rule above (a package-less row that bears a package-held name is a customization, never a second item) and R15 are read at D4's action key (package, objectName, name), not at (type, name). A package-less action row bound to an object that no holder of the name binds it to is the environment's own bucket-4 item on that object, beside each holder's item. It is never written into a holder, read as a holder's overlay, or moved by ADR-0146 D11's migration. An object-less action is its own key (global). A package-less row on the object a holder binds stays that holder's customization, and R15 is unchanged for it. The save doors write accordingly (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts`, `actionHeldOnlyOnOtherObjects`, and the draft address in `sys-metadata-repository.ts`). The read envelope and the action route already key by object (#33898). Moving a package's own action to another object takes a save naming the package (`?package=P`).

R15 row, notes column, append: "for an action, over a holder's (objectName, name) only (amendment note under D4)."

## Companion line (domain:spec, may ride this card's PR or the spec lane's next touch of the file)

The `SaveMetaItemRequest.packageId` `.describe` in `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`, mirrored in `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx`, states the package-less active-save address rule without the action exception. It should name the exception in one clause.

## Order

Land after PR #34238 merges, so the note's file pointers name merged code. Read side: #33904, the by-name read and list half of the same ruling.
